articles.summary: This collection contains excerpts from interviews with people whose work we respect and whose answers we offered to publish without attribution. This means that these quotes don't represent the views of 80,000 Hours, and indeed in some cases, individual pieces of advice explicitly contradict our own. Nonetheless, we think it's valuable to showcase the range of views on difficult topics where reasonable people might disagree. Did you just land on our site for the first time?
articles.title: Anonymous answers: the complete collection

articles.summary: Retail in Pakistan is informal and fragmented — 91% of retail flows through independent ‘mom-and-pop’ stores.Because of this fragmentation, stores struggle to buy inventory. Today, stores spend hours every week dealing with dozens of different suppliers. They passively wait for sale
articles.title: Empowering mom-and-pop stores to grow their business

articles.summary: Although chlorine is great for pools, it's not so great for our curls. We've asked Kierra Smith to take us on her curl journey and how she manages to keep her curls looking fresh even when she is in chlorine daily.
articles.title: Stroke-By-Stroke: A Journey to Self Love
